extracted.intended_audience: NIH K-award applicants / grant applicants and institutional grant administrators
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and required content for NIH-style grant application components (Facilities & Other Resources, Equipment lists, Senior/Key Person Profile and Biographical Sketch) as used in a K08 career development application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities & Other Resources — laboratory description
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe laboratory space and capabilities (e.g., 'The laboratory of Dr. Robert Siliciano... includes 2,200 square feet of laboratory space, a 670 square foot BSL-3 laboratory ... The main laboratory includes a BSL-2 tissue culture room equipped with 2 cell culture hoods, 2 humidified incubators, centrifuges and microscopes. There are two dedicated PCR setup rooms. One has four laminar flow hoods, and the other - specifically dedicated to droplet digital PCR setup - has two laminar flow hoods. The laboratory has a large, walk-in cold room as well as a dark room...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List specific rooms/equipment, biosafety level labs, dedicated setup rooms (e.g., ddPCR setup), and mention that 'All assays proposed in this application have been either developed in this laboratory or have been used regularly in this laboratory.' Include capabilities such as PBMC processing, leukapheresis processing, glass-washing and autoclaving services, and any daily services provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities & Other Resources — BSL-3 laboratory capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Detail BSL-3 resources and equipment (e.g., 'The BSL-3 laboratory is equipped with five tissue culture hoods, six humidified incubators, one Sony SH800 Cell Sorter, four flow cytometers (BD FACS Calibur, BD FACS Canto Millipore Muse, and Intellicyte iQue Plus Screener), four -80 freezers, 5 centrifuges, 2 ultracentrifuges, a pass-through autoclave, large-scale cell separation magnets, automated cell separation workstation, automated RNA isolation workstation...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the BSL-3-specific processing capabilities (e.g., process and isolate PBMCs from routine draws, leukaphereses, cryopreserved samples) and list instrumentation and services that enable the proposed work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core Laboratory Facilities access
rubrics_metrics.description: Document access to institutional core facilities (e.g., 'access to the Bloomberg School of Public Health’s Core Flow Cytometry facility... Next generation sequencing (Illumina MiSeq and many others) is available via the Johns Hopkins Deep Sequencing and Microarray Core Facility. Sanger sequencing is available via GeneWiz...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify nearby cores, their capabilities (live cell sorting, NGS platforms), and logistical details (distance, daily order pickup sites) to show feasibility and turnaround for proposed assays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical Facilities and patient resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe clinical sites and services available to the PI (e.g., 'The newly opened John G. Bartlett Specialty Practice... is within a five minute walk of Dr. Antar’s office. The Barlett clinics are a state-of-the-art, 25 exam room clinic offering services for patients with HIV... A pharmacy is located on-site, as are phlebotomists... Our HIV clinic has delivered care to over 7,000 patients since 1984. Dr. Antar will enrich her patient panel with suboptimal immune responders.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document multidisciplinary clinical support, proximity to lab/office, inpatient services (e.g., Polk Service), and institutional designations (e.g., ACTG site) to demonstrate clinical access for subject recruitment and specimen collection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical Samples / Cohort availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Document cohorts and sample availability with specifics (e.g., 'The Johns Hopkins HIV Clinical Cohort... ~9,000 adults... yearly blood samples are cryopreserved... SCOPE has enrolled over 2,000 adults... collection of >250 research leukaphereses, >1500 flexible sigmoidoscopies... CLIF cohort... clinical data and cryopreserved PBMCs... ALLRT... data and biologic specimens collected every 4 months for over 5,000 participants with follow-up up to 10 years. Individuals can be brought back for extra sample collections if needed.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide cohort names, sample counts/types, frequency of collection, and explicit commitments (samples already provided or identification underway) to support feasibility of proposed human-subject or translational studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office and computing resources
rubrics_metrics.description: List office space, computing hardware, software and data storage available to the PI (e.g., 'Office resources include high-speed wireless internet, color laser printing, photocopying, scanning, and fax machines... Dell Latitude E7470 laptop... Dell desktop... access to a suite of Windows-compatible and Macintosh computers... access to Microsoft Office, CLC Genomics Workbench, Mega7, CodonCode Aligner, Anaconda, GPower, Matlab, Past, Adobe Illustrator, Graphpad Prism, RefWorks, and the Johns Hopkins electronic medical record... access to 80 GB of data storage on Johns Hopkins-maintained personal and laboratory network folders.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify hardware specs, available software packages relevant to proposed analyses, network access, and storage quotas to show that computational needs will be met.

rubrics_metrics.name: Educational and career development resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe local training, coursework, workshops and programs (e.g., 'A wide array of relevant research, clinical, and career-related conferences and workshops are available and in close proximity... advanced coursework offered at the School of Medicine and the Bloomberg School of Public Health... see the Plan for Career Development for specific planned coursework, conferences, and workshops.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List institutional programs (CFAR workshops, K-to-R Transition Program, K2R club), mentorship opportunities, and tuition remission that support the trainee's career development plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Library and informationist support
rubrics_metrics.description: Document library services (e.g., 'The William H. Welch Medical Library... a trained informationist assigned to the infectious diseases division to help with systematic literature and genome searches, electronic access to hundreds of thousands of medical journals and books, and off-campus access to the entire online collection.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note availability of specialized librarian/informationist support, electronic access, and other library services that facilitate literature review and data searches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional investment and protected time
rubrics_metrics.description: State institutional commitments to the PI (e.g., 'The Division of Infectious Diseases has offered 80% protected time for research and career training activities once Dr. Antar becomes an Assistant Professor... For the 2018-2019 academic year, Dr. Antar has 90% protected time. Tuition remission up to $ per year... The Johns Hopkins CFAR provides biostatistical support and support for Institutional Review Board submissions... CFAR offers several Grants for Faculty Development... hosts an active "K-to-R" Transition Program... Task Force on Women’s Academic Careers... Division of Infectious Diseases also has an active Women in ID networking group...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document percent protected effort, tuition support, availability of internal pilot or development grants, statistical and regulatory support, and mentoring/ networking programs demonstrating institutional commitment to the applicant’s success.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment inventory
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a detailed equipment list available to the project (e.g., 'Flow cytometers – Siliciano Laboratory (4) and Johns Hopkins core facilities; Sony SH800 Cell Sorter (1); Tissue culture hoods (11); Tissue culture incubators (8); Microscopes (4); Microplate readers (2); ELISA plate washers (1); Thermal cyclers (20+); Ultracentrifuges (2); Real-Time PCR Machines (1) and Digital Droplet PCR System (1); Gel imaging system (1); Automated liquid handling – Johns Hopkins HIT Center; Intellicyt iQue Screener Plus (1); ... -80C freezers (6), multiple refrigerators; Pass-through autoclave. Note: the numerous Johns Hopkins core facilities are equipped to meet a wide range of research needs.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List counts and locations of major instruments, specialized devices (cell sorters, ddPCR, ultracentrifuges), and confirm core facility backups; be explicit about institutional coverage for uncommon/expensive instrumentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: RESEARCH & RELATED Senior/Key Person Profile (Expanded) — required profile fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete the expanded Senior/Key Person Profile with required fields (form header shows: 'PROFILE - Project Director/Principal Investigator', 'OMB Number: 4040-0001', fields including Prefix, First Name*, Middle Name, Last Name*, Suffix, Post-doctoral Fellow, Organization Name*, Department, Division, City, State, Country, Position/Title*, Phone Number*, E-Mail*, Project Role*: PD/PI, Degree Type: MD, PHD, Attach Biographical Sketch*, Attach Current & Pending Support*.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide every requested data field for each senior/key personnel. Attach required documents (biographical sketch, current & pending support). Ensure Project Role and Degree Type are specified. Follow the expanded profile format exactly as shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. 'Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere strictly to the five-page maximum and the specified format when preparing each biographical sketch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch — Education/Training section
rubrics_metrics.description: Include EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.) with columns for INSTITUTION AND LOCATION, DEGREE (if applicable), Completion Date MM/YYYY, and FIELD OF STUDY.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List educational history beginning with the earliest degree; include completion dates and fields; add or remove rows to match the individual's training history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch — Personal Statement and Contributions
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a Personal Statement that summarizes the individual's research focus, qualifications and how they are well-suited for the role, followed by sections such as Positions and Honors and Contributions to Science (numbered entries with supporting citations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Personal Statement to articulate research goals, relevant experience, and training needs. In Contributions to Science, summarize major contributions with references and context; follow the order and section headings shown on the form.
